items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a guy that played flute and saxophone and sang beautiful, named Leroy Harris.

ctx.x: Willy Randall. And I had a guy that played flute and saxophone and sang beautiful, named Leroy Harris. I had the great "Streamline" on trombone. John Ewing was his name. He's in Los Angeles. I'm pretty sure he's still out there. I had another trombonist. He's from Chicago, named Ed Fat, and he had a lot of drive. He was quite a guy. I also had that great lead alto saxophonist with me, Omer Simeon. Used to play all that dixieland on his clarinet. So I had a real good band with me.

: Yeah. That's great. I'd like to ask some questions before we really continue on the years here. Something about -- some musical questions. When you were playing these ballrooms such as this -- of course, you were doing reviews, did you play only the show or did you play for dance music in between, or concertized, or -- how did that work out?
